children.name: ZIA - Behavior
children.description: The Zscaler - Behavior Dashboard focuses on allowed traffic behaviors, showing trends and deviations by users, content types accessed, content categories, super categories, and bandwidth trends.
children.title: ZIA - Behavior

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA* "Allowed" 
| json field=_raw "event.user", "event.responsesize", "event.serverip", "event.threatname", "event.action" as src_user,dest_bytes, dest_ip, threatname, action
| where action = "Allowed" and threatname = "None" and src_user matches "{{user}}"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_name from geo://location on dest_ip=ip
| sum(dest_bytes) as mb by country_name 
| mb/1024/1024 as mb
| total mb as total_mb
| (mb/total_mb)*100 as percent
| format("%.2f",percent) as percent
| fields -total_mb
| sort mb
| Limit 5
| format("%.1f",mb) as mb

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA* "Allowed" 
| json field=_raw "event.user", "event.requestsize", "event.serverip", "event.threatname", "event.action" as src_user,src_bytes, dest_ip, threatname, action
| where action = "Allowed" and threatname = "None" and src_user matches "{{user}}"
| lookup latitude, longitude, country_name from geo://location on dest_ip=ip
| sum(src_bytes) as mb by country_name 
| mb/1024/1024 as mb
| total mb as total_mb
| (mb/total_mb)*100 as percent
| format("%.2f",percent) as percent
| fields -total_mb
| sort mb
| Limit 5
| format("%.1f",mb) as mb

panels.title: Destination vs Source Volume by Category

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA* "Allowed" 
| json field=_raw "event.user" ,"event.requestsize", "event.responsesize", "event.urlcategory", "event.action" as src_user, src_bytes, dest_bytes, category, action
| where action = "Allowed" and src_user matches "{{user}}"
| src_bytes/1024/1024 as src_bytes 
| dest_bytes/1024/1024 as dest_bytes 
| timeslice 5m
| sum(src_bytes) as src_mb, sum(dest_bytes) as dest_mb by _timeslice, category
| transpose row _timeslice column category

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA* !"general browsing" //ensure no nones and nulls
| json field=_raw "event.clientpublicIP", "event.user", "event.appclass" as src_ip, src_user, appclass
| where  src_user matches "{{user}}"
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice, appclass
| transpose row _timeslice column appclass

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA* !"general browsing" //ensure no nones and nulls
| json field=_raw "event.clientpublicIP", "event.user", "event.appname" as src_ip, src_user, application
| where  src_user matches "{{user}}"
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice, application
| transpose row _timeslice column application

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA* !"general browsing" //ensure no nones and nulls
| json field=_raw "event.clientpublicIP", "event.user" as src_ip, src_user
| where src_user matches "*@*"  and src_user matches "{{user}}"
| timeslice 5m
| count by _timeslice, src_user
| sort by _timeslice, _count
| 1 as rownum
| accum rownum as index by _timeslice
| if(index=1, 1,0) as isFirst
| accum isFirst as rankOrder
| where index <= 10
| fields _timeslice, src_user, _count
| transpose row _timeslice column src_user

children.name: ZIA - Logs
children.description: The ZIA - Logs Dashboard gives insights into different logs being produced in the Zscaler environment.
children.title: ZIA - Logs

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA*
| json "sourcetype", "event.user" as sourcetype, user
| where user matches "{{user}}"
| count by sourcetype

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA*
| json "sourcetype", "event.event_id", "event.protocol", "event.action", "event.urlcategory", "event.serverip", "event.location", "event.ClientIP", "event.user", "event.hostname", "event.clientpublicIP", "event.threatname", "event.threatcategory", "event.appname", "event.threatclass", "event.urlclass" as sourcetype,event_id,protocol,action,urlcategory,serverip,location,ClientIP,user,hostname,clientpublicIP,threatname,threatcategory, appname,threatclass,urlclass nodrop
| where sourcetype = "zscalernss-web" and user matches "{{user}}"
| count by sourcetype,event_id,protocol,action,urlcategory,serverip,location,ClientIP,user,hostname,clientpublicIP,threatname,threatcategory, appname,threatclass,urlclass
| fields sourcetype,event_id,protocol,action,urlcategory,serverip,location,ClientIP,user,hostname,clientpublicIP,threatname,threatcategory, appname,threatclass,urlclass
| limit 1000

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA*
| json field=_raw "sourcetype", "event.Recordtype", "event.tunneltype", "event.user", "event.sourceip", "event.destinationip", "event.event", "event.location" as sourcetype,Recordtype, tunneltype, user, sourceip, destinationip, event, location nodrop
| where sourcetype = "zscalernss-tunnel" and user matches "{{user}}"
| count by Recordtype, tunneltype, user, sourceip, destinationip, event, location
| fields Recordtype, tunneltype, user, sourceip, destinationip, event, location
| limit 1000

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA*
| json field=_raw "sourcetype", "event.user", "event.department", "event.location", "event.reqaction", "event.resaction", "event.reqrulelabel", "event.resrulelabel", "event.dns_req", "event.dns_reqtype" , "event.dns_resp", "event.durationms", "event.srv_dip", "event.clt_sip", "event.category"  as sourcetype, user, department, location, reqaction, resaction, reqrulelabel, resrulelabel, dns_req, dns_reqtype, dns_resp, durationms, srv_dip, clt_sip, category nodrop
| where sourcetype = "zscalernss-dns" and user matches "{{user}}"
| count by user, department, location, reqaction, resaction, reqrulelabel, resrulelabel, dns_req, dns_reqtype, dns_resp, durationms, srv_dip, clt_sip, category
| fields user, department, location, reqaction, resaction, reqrulelabel, resrulelabel, dns_req, dns_reqtype, dns_resp, durationms, srv_dip, clt_sip, category
| limit 1000

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA*
| json field=_raw "sourcetype", "event.user", "event.locationname", "event.action", "event.tuntype", "event.protocol", "event.destcountry", "event.rulelable", "event.threatcat", "event.threatname" as sourcetype, user, location, action, tuntype, protocol, destcountry, rulelable, threat_category, threat_name nodrop
| where sourcetype = "zscalernss-fw" and user matches "{{user}}"
| count by sourcetype, user, location, action, tuntype, protocol, destcountry, rulelable, threat_category, threat_name
| fields sourcetype, user, location, action, tuntype, protocol, destcountry, rulelable, threat_category, threat_name
| limit 1000

children.name: ZIA - Overview
children.description: The Zscaler - Overview Dashboard provides general information of the Zscaler Web Security logs, including Panels that drill-down into the other Zscaler Dashboards. The Overview Dashboard gives a good starting point for detecting anomalies in blocked traffic and geographic hotspots for allowed and blocked traffic.
children.title: ZIA - Overview

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA*  filetype
| json field=_raw "event.filetype", "event.threatname", "event.user" as filetype, threatname, user

| count by _timeslice,action

| where sourcetype = "zscalernss-tunnel" and (Recordtype="Tunnel Event" OR Recordtype="IPSec Phase2" OR Recordtype="IPSec Phase1") and user matches "{{user}}"

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA*

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA*

_sourceCategory = Labs/ZIA*
| json field=_raw "event.clientpublicIP", "event.user", "event.urlcategory", "event.reason", "event.urlclass", "event.threatname", "event.threatcategory", "event.location" as src_ip, src_user, category, reason, urlclass, threatname, threatcategory, location
